parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities act JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = act.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno JOIN assays a ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = a.tid WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3880' AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
